titleZh: 外人難以加入的小圈子

brief.meaningEn: A small social or professional group that gives outsiders little opportunity to enter or contribute.
brief.meaningZh: 讓外人少有加入或作貢獻機會的小社交或專業群體。
brief.grammar: become/remain a closed circle; circle is a group metaphor, not a drawn shape.
brief.register: Usually critical of exclusion rather than simply a small group.
brief.boundaryZh: 成員少不必等於排外；要看有沒有可理解的加入或意見管道。保護合理私隱也不自動等於不公平排斥。
brief.misconceptionZh: 認識現有成員不是所有選拔的合理唯一門檻；公開資訊及有意義申請可打開機會。
brief.outcomeZh: 能以進入與發聲條件區分小團體及封閉圈子。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Without open applications, the programme may become a closed circle.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 7, table 1, row 8; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: The programme risked becoming a closed circle when invitations went only to friends of current members and no application route was advertised.
listening.zh: 邀請只給現有成員朋友、又沒有公布申請途徑時，計劃有變成封閉小圈子的風險。

options.en: A small initial membership with a clear public application route.
options.zh: 初期成員少，但有清楚公開申請途徑。

options.en: Entry depended on existing personal connections without an open route.
options.zh: 加入靠已有私人關係，沒有公開途徑。

options.en: Members discussed private personal details respectfully.
options.zh: 成員尊重地討論私人細節。

options.en: The programme openly invited people beyond the existing friendship group.
options.zh: 計劃公開邀請現有朋友圈以外的人。

listening.explanationZh: friends only 與無申請途徑指向排外機制，非單憑人數少。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼你擔心計劃不容易讓新面孔加入？
reply.promptEn: Why are you concerned that new people may struggle to join the programme?

options.en: Only friends of current members received invitations.
options.zh: 只有現有成員朋友收到邀請。

options.en: It could become a closed circle without an open application route.
options.zh: 沒有公開申請途徑，它可能成為封閉小圈子。

options.en: Outsiders had no clear way to put themselves forward.
options.zh: 圈外人沒有清楚自薦方法。

options.en: Entry appeared to depend on who you already knew.
options.zh: 加入似乎取決於本來認識誰。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都交代進入限制；金句未只按規模判斷。

scene.promptZh: 讀書會只有六人，但公開介紹、接受新申請並輪流聽新人意見。哪句較準確？

options.en: Six members alone prove it is a closed circle.
options.zh: 只有六位成員已證明它是封閉圈子。

options.en: Its small size does not by itself make it a closed circle; the entry route is open.
options.zh: 人數少本身不使它成為封閉圈子；加入途徑公開。

options.en: Any privacy in the meeting means outsiders have been unfairly excluded.
options.zh: 聚會有任何私隱就表示圈外人被不公平排斥。

scene.explanationZh: 需看加入及參與途徑，不只看人數或合理私隱。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不支持 a closed circle 的批評？

options.en: Only members’ friends can hear about opportunities.
options.zh: 只有成員朋友可得知機會。

options.en: Newcomers have no way to apply or contribute.
options.zh: 新手沒有申請或作貢獻方法。

options.en: A small group publishes its entry criteria and genuinely considers new applicants.
options.zh: 小團體公布加入標準，並認真考慮新申請者。

contrast.explanationZh: 透明且有意義的新申請途徑不符封閉門檻。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說「成員少，就一定 a closed circle」。哪句澄清最好？

options.en: We should check how people can join and contribute, not infer exclusion from size alone.
options.zh: 我們應查人們怎樣加入及作貢獻，不只按人數推斷排斥。

options.en: Headcount is enough to judge access without looking at invitations or applications.
options.zh: 不用看邀請或申請，人數已足以判斷加入機會。

options.en: A large group cannot exclude outsiders, regardless of its entry rules.
options.zh: 不論加入規則，龐大團體都不可能排斥圈外人。

dialogue.explanationZh: 規模與進入機制不同；大群體也可有封閉門檻。

speaking.en: Without an open route for newcomers, the project could become a closed circle.
speaking.zh: 沒有讓新人加入的公開途徑，項目可能成為封閉小圈子。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再把封閉風險連結到實際進入條件。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：創作組每次只讓同三位老朋友互評，從不讓新作者提交意見，想法也越來越相似。你想建議清楚開放回饋管道，而非只擴大老朋友名單。用一至兩句英文說明。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出發聲管道封閉，提出真正讓新人加入的途徑；不把人數少或朋友關係本身當作唯一證據。

examples.en: Our feedback process risks becoming a closed circle if only the same friends can contribute. We should offer new writers a clear way to submit comments.
examples.zh: 若只有同一批朋友可作貢獻，回饋流程有變成封閉圈子的風險。我們應讓新作者有清楚提交意見途徑。

examples.en: To avoid a closed circle, the group needs meaningful access for fresh voices, not simply more comments from existing friends.
examples.zh: 為避免封閉圈子，小組需要真正讓新聲音加入，而不只多收老朋友意見。

takeaways.en: The scheme became a closed circle when entry depended only on personal invitations.
takeaways.zh: 加入只靠私人邀請時，計劃變成封閉圈子。

takeaways.en: A small club need not be a closed circle if newcomers have a fair route in.
takeaways.zh: 新人有公平加入途徑時，小社團不必是封閉圈子。

brief.meaningEn: A small number of people or things, without specifying an exact count.
brief.meaningZh: 少數幾個人或事物，沒有指定確切數目。
brief.grammar: a handful of + plural count noun; this lesson teaches small number rather than a literal hand full.
brief.register: Common quantity expression.
brief.boundaryZh: 常表示相對少，不固定等於五個；小數目也不決定重要程度或能否代表全體。
brief.misconceptionZh: 只有少數回覆不等於沒有人，也不能由少數意見直接斷定全體一致。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述少量及保留未量明的數目與代表性限制。

listening.en: Only a handful of members replied to the first survey, so we asked for more responses before drawing a conclusion about the whole club.
listening.zh: 只有少數會員回覆首次調查，所以斷定全社團意見前，我們要求更多回覆。
listening.promptZh: 為甚麼小組仍想收更多回覆？

options.en: The initial replies came from relatively few members.
options.zh: 最初回覆只來自較少會員。

options.en: No member had replied at all.
options.zh: 完全沒有會員回覆。

options.en: Every member had already given the same answer.
options.zh: 每位會員已給相同答案。

options.en: The phrase fixes the number of respondents at exactly five.
options.zh: 片語把回覆者數目定為剛好五位。

listening.explanationZh: handful 表少量，不是零或固定五位；少量未必代表整體。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼你還不想對全社團意見下結論？
reply.promptEn: Why are you not ready to conclude what the whole club thinks?

options.en: Too few members have answered so far.
options.zh: 目前回答會員太少。

options.en: Only a handful of members have replied.
options.zh: 只有少數會員已回覆。

options.en: We need more responses to understand the wider group.
options.zh: 我們需更多回覆了解較大群體。

options.en: The first responses may not reflect everyone’s views.
options.zh: 首批回覆未必反映每個人的意見。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都交代樣本範圍限制；金句不是確切數字。

scene.promptZh: 展演還有少量座位，但未給確切數目。哪句忠實描述？

options.en: There are no seats left.
options.zh: 已沒有座位。

options.en: There are still plenty of seats available.
options.zh: 仍有很多座位可用。

options.en: There are only a handful of seats left.
options.zh: 只剩少數座位。

scene.explanationZh: 少量剩餘不是零，亦不保證不限需求。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個理解最不符合 a handful of participants？

options.en: A small number of participants.
options.zh: 少數參加者。

options.en: Exactly five participants in every context.
options.zh: 每種情境都剛好五位參加者。

options.en: Fewer participants than a large group, without a precise total stated.
options.zh: 比大群體少，但未給確切總數的參加者。

contrast.explanationZh: 不是按一隻手五指固定數目。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說「a handful of 回覆者，所以他們的意見完全沒有價值」。哪句回應最好？

options.en: Their views may be useful, but we should not assume they represent the whole group.
options.zh: 意見可能有用，但不應假定代表整個群體。

options.en: Small numbers make individual experiences irrelevant before we read them.
options.zh: 人數少，表示未讀之前個人經驗已不相關。

options.en: A few responses let us conclude that all members agree with them.
options.zh: 少量回覆讓我們可斷定所有會員都同意。

dialogue.explanationZh: 價值與代表性不同；少量可有用但不能自動推及全體。

speaking.en: Only a handful of people replied, so we need a wider range of views.
speaking.zh: 只有少數人回覆，所以我們需要較廣泛看法。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再保留小數目與代表性限制。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你校對一本很長的小冊，大部分圖說已核對，只剩少數仍需確認姓名，未有確切數目。用一至兩句英文報告進度，不說全部完成。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以少量未查的圖說報告進度，保留未完成，不自行改成確切五個或完全沒有剩餘。

examples.en: Only a handful of captions still need their names checked; most of the booklet has already been reviewed.
examples.zh: 只有少數圖說仍需核對姓名；小冊大部分已覆核。

examples.en: We have reviewed most pages, but a handful of captions remain unchecked, so the final review is not complete yet.
examples.zh: 我們已覆核大部分頁面，但少數圖說仍未查核，所以最後覆核尚未完成。

takeaways.en: Only a handful of tickets remained by lunchtime.
takeaways.zh: 午間只剩少量門票。

takeaways.en: A handful of useful comments can still reveal an issue worth checking.
takeaways.zh: 少量有用意見仍可揭示值得查核的問題。

titleZh: 文化被限在少數人可進的範圍

brief.meaningEn: Separated from ordinary public access, as if reserved for a privileged few.
brief.meaningZh: 與普通大眾接觸隔開，彷彿只保留給少數有特權的人。
brief.grammar: keep/stay behind velvet ropes; locked behind a velvet rope intensifies the same access-barrier image.
brief.register: Creative social-access metaphor, drawing on roped-off spaces.
brief.boundaryZh: 不必真的有繩，也不把所有保護展品或合理限制都當排外；需交代誰被擋在外及原因。
brief.misconceptionZh: 讓更多人接觸文化不等於可觸碰脆弱展品或不顧合理保護；本課談不必要的社群進入門檻。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述文化資源與大眾隔離的比喻，提出具體可接觸途徑而保留必要保護。

sources.sentence: Cultural events should not be locked behind a velvet rope.

listening.en: The writer argued that local art should not remain behind velvet ropes, available only to invited guests rather than the people whose neighbourhood it represents.
listening.zh: 作者認為本地藝術不應被限在特權圈內，只供受邀嘉賓，而不讓作品所代表的社區居民接觸。

options.en: Giving the wider local community a meaningful way to access the art.
options.zh: 讓較廣本地社群有真正接觸藝術的途徑。

options.en: Requiring every visitor to touch all fragile exhibits.
options.zh: 要求每位訪客觸碰所有脆弱展品。

options.en: Ordinary residents already have the same access as the invited guests.
options.zh: 普通居民已有與受邀嘉賓相同接觸機會。

options.en: Keeping access limited to the same invited group.
options.zh: 讓接觸機會只限原本受邀群體。

listening.explanationZh: 只給受邀嘉賓、鄰里被排除，支持社群進入門檻；不能說居民已有相同途徑，亦不等於要求任意觸碰作品。

reply.promptZh: 作者為甚麼想讓更多居民接觸這些作品？
reply.promptEn: Why does the writer want more residents to have access to these works?

options.en: The works reflect their neighbourhood, but ordinary residents are excluded.
options.zh: 作品反映他們社區，普通居民卻被排除。

options.en: Local art should not stay behind velvet ropes for invited guests alone.
options.zh: 本地藝術不應只供受邀嘉賓，與大眾隔開。

options.en: Cultural participation should include people beyond the invitation list.
options.zh: 文化參與應包括邀請名單以外的人。

options.en: The current access rule leaves out the community represented in the art.
options.zh: 現有進入規則漏掉藝術所代表的社群。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都指向社群接觸，不是取消所有展品保護。

scene.promptZh: 社區史展只向固定私人名單開放，相關居民沒有申請或觀看途徑。哪句貼切？

options.en: The exhibition is effectively behind velvet ropes for the community it describes.
options.zh: 對它描述的社群而言，展覽實際被限在少數人可進的範圍。

options.en: The residents already have a clear public route to view the display.
options.zh: 居民已有清楚公開觀看途徑。

options.en: The invitation rule only asks visitors not to touch one fragile object, without restricting entry.
options.zh: 邀請規則只要求別碰一件脆弱物品，沒有限制進入。

scene.explanationZh: 私人固定名單與無申請途徑是進入限制，不只是保護物件。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以單獨支持這種排外的 behind velvet ropes 比喻？

options.en: A local collection is shown only to an unchanging private list.
options.zh: 本地收藏只向固定私人名單展示。

options.en: People represented in the work have no route to view it.
options.zh: 作品所代表的人沒有觀看途徑。

options.en: Everyone can book a public visit, with a no-touch rule protecting a fragile object.
options.zh: 人人可預約公開參觀，但有不觸碰規則保護脆弱物件。

contrast.explanationZh: 合理物件保護與不必要的大眾進入門檻不同。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說「不留在 velvet ropes 後面，就要讓人摸全部展品」。哪句回應最好？

options.en: Broader access can coexist with rules that protect fragile work.
options.zh: 較廣接觸可以與保護脆弱作品的規則並存。

options.en: A public viewing route requires removing every conservation limit.
options.zh: 公開觀看途徑要求移除每項保護限制。

options.en: Keeping one object untouchable proves the whole exhibition is socially exclusive.
options.zh: 一件物品不能觸碰，已證明整個展覽在社會上排外。

dialogue.explanationZh: 觀看參與與觸碰許可是不同問題，無需二選一。

speaking.en: Local culture should not remain behind velvet ropes for a small invited group alone.
speaking.zh: 本地文化不應只供小批受邀者，與大眾隔開。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再描述社群接觸文化的門檻。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：一項收錄居民口述故事的數碼文化計劃，現時密碼只給固定圈內人，提供故事的街坊也沒有查詢或聆聽途徑。虛構題目已說這些錄音獲准公開，你想建議清楚大眾接觸途徑。用一至兩句英文描述，不主張公開未獲准的私人資料。
writing.selfCheckZh: 把已准公開卻不合理限圈的錄音與進入門檻連起來，不推成所有私人或保護資料都應公開。

examples.en: The approved public recordings should not remain behind velvet ropes online; residents need a clear route to listen to the stories they helped create.
examples.zh: 已准公開的錄音不應在線上仍與大眾隔開；居民需要清楚途徑聆聽自己參與創作的故事。

examples.en: Keeping these public stories locked behind a velvet rope of insider passwords excludes the contributors, so the project should explain how residents can gain access.
examples.zh: 把這些公開故事鎖在圈內密碼的無形繩索後，排除了貢獻者，所以計劃應說清居民怎樣接觸。

takeaways.en: The writer wanted art to move beyond a world kept behind velvet ropes.
takeaways.zh: 作者希望藝術走出被限在少數人可進的世界。

takeaways.en: The neighbourhood’s stories should not be locked behind a velvet rope when public access has already been approved.
takeaways.zh: 既已准公開接觸，社區故事就不應再被無形繩索鎖在圈內。

brief.meaningEn: Participate in an activity by doing something as one of those involved.
brief.meaningZh: 作為參與者在活動中實際做一些事情。
brief.grammar: take part in + activity/noun/-ing; past took part in; part is fixed in this participation expression.
brief.register: Common conventional participation phrase, not an opaque idiom.
brief.boundaryZh: 不必領導、獲勝或做最多，也不單憑報名或路過就證明已參與；需有活動中的投入。
brief.misconceptionZh: 小角色也可參與；觀看者是否算參與要看活動設計，不能不交代便混為實際做任務。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述具體參與方式，區分參與、報名及結果。

listening.en: I took part in the neighbourhood survey by interviewing two residents and recording their answers, although I did not lead the project.
listening.zh: 我透過訪問兩位居民並記錄答案，參與社區調查，雖然不是項目負責人。
listening.promptZh: 甚麼顯示說話者實際參與？

options.en: They carried out interviews and recorded answers.
options.zh: 他進行訪問並記錄答案。

options.en: They only saw the project title without doing any activity.
options.zh: 他只看項目名稱，沒有做任何活動。

options.en: They became the sole leader of every stage.
options.zh: 他成為每個階段唯一負責人。

options.en: They registered an interest but never joined the survey work.
options.zh: 他登記有興趣，但從未加入調查工作。

listening.explanationZh: 具體訪問及記錄是參與，不需領導，也不是只登記。

reply.promptZh: 你有沒有實際參與社區調查？
reply.promptEn: Did you actually participate in the neighbourhood survey?

options.en: Yes, I interviewed residents and wrote down their answers.
options.zh: 有，我訪問居民並記下答案。

options.en: Yes, I took part in the survey as an interviewer.
options.zh: 有，我以訪問者身份參與調查。

options.en: Yes, I helped collect responses even though someone else led it.
options.zh: 有，雖然別人負責，我有幫忙收集回覆。

options.en: Yes, I contributed to the fieldwork rather than just signing up.
options.zh: 有，我有參與實地工作，而不只報名。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都交代實際投入；金句不要求領導或獲勝。

scene.promptZh: 同學負責整理一份合作展板的資料，並非主持人或得獎者。哪句有根據？

options.en: She did not participate because she was not the presenter.
options.zh: 她不是主持人，所以沒有參與。

options.en: She took part in the project by organising information for the display.
options.zh: 她透過整理展板資料參與項目。

options.en: She can be called a participant only if the display wins a prize.
options.zh: 只有展板得獎，她才可稱參與者。

scene.explanationZh: 有實際任務便可參與，不需主持或得獎。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以單獨支持 take part in the task？

options.en: Helping to collect information used in the group’s work.
options.zh: 幫忙收集小組工作所用資料。

options.en: Completing an agreed small role during the activity.
options.zh: 在活動中完成議定小角色。

options.en: Adding a name to an interest list but never joining the activity or contributing.
options.zh: 把名字加到興趣名單，卻從未加入活動或作貢獻。

contrast.explanationZh: 只有表示興趣未顯示實際參與。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說「你沒領導也沒得獎，就不能說 took part in」。哪句澄清最好？

options.en: Participation requires being the main leader, regardless of other contributions.
options.zh: 參與要求成為主要領導，不論其他貢獻。

options.en: Only the winning team’s members can describe themselves as taking part.
options.zh: 只有勝出隊員可說自己參與。

options.en: A person can contribute a real role without leading or winning.
options.zh: 一個人可以有實際角色，而不需領導或獲勝。

dialogue.explanationZh: 參與描述投入方式，領導及獲勝是另外判斷。

speaking.en: I took part in the project by helping to collect and organise the information.
speaking.zh: 我透過幫忙收集及整理資料參與項目。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再用具體角色說明參與。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區聲音節目邀街坊分享回憶，你沒有主持或操作設備，只錄了一段自己童年故事，讓節目使用。用一至兩句英文描述實際參與，不把角色小當作沒貢獻。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫錄製故事的具體投入，保留未主持的事實；不以領導、獲勝或角色大小決定是否參與。

examples.en: I took part in the community programme by recording a childhood memory, even though I did not host the show.
examples.zh: 我透過錄製童年回憶參與社區節目，雖然不是主持。

examples.en: Recording my story let me take part in the project with a small but real contribution.
examples.zh: 錄製自己的故事讓我用小而實在的貢獻參與項目。

takeaways.en: Everyone can take part in the workshop through an appropriate activity.
takeaways.zh: 每個人都可透過合適活動參與工作坊。

takeaways.en: She took part in the discussion without being its leader.
takeaways.zh: 她參與討論，但不是討論領導者。
